summary_1line: Vyasa recounts how King Srinjaya’s boon-born golden son was kidnapped and killed by robbers, leading to grief and illustrating the futility of wealth and fate.

image_candidates.scene_text: Greedy robbers in a forest tear apart the body of the kidnapped golden prince, searching in vain for gold within him.
The two sages Narada and Parvata glare at each other in anger while exchanging curses in King Srinjaya’s court.
King Srinjaya’s palace gleams with gold—walls, beds, vessels, and chariots—after the birth of his miraculous son.
